Recurring themes

Japanese Boat License Practice Exams — Answered Study Notes

Source files: `All Practice Exams.rtf` for text structure and `OriginalFile.pdf` for figures and authoritative answer sheets.

Probability is an estimate from recurrence inside this practice-exam collection. It means the likelihood that the same theme or very similar question appears, not an official prediction of the live exam.

For figure-heavy questions, use the listed PDF page as the visual source.

What "Probability" means: it is a recurrence estimate computed from how often the same theme reappears across these 10 collected practice exams — it is a heuristic ranking (a fixed lookup table by exam coverage, +bonus for exact repeats), not a calibrated statistical forecast. These 10 exams are real past official exams, so theme recurrence is a genuinely useful study-priority signal, but the exact percentage number shouldn't be read as "this question has a 96% chance of appearing."

The green "verbatim in N/10 exams" tag is the stronger, more literal signal: it means that exact question (word-for-word or near-identical) was found in N of the 10 real past exams — hover it to see which ones. Japan's small-craft operator exam is known to reuse questions from a standing bank rather than writing new ones each sitting, so a question that already repeats verbatim across several past exams is a good bet to study closely; a single-occurrence question is a weaker bet even if its general theme is common.

Figure-based questions embed the original exam page as a reference image — click any figure to open it full-size.
